# QuickJS-ng 0.18.0 (amalgamated)

JavaScript engine used by Kaint to run paint.js plugins (`.paintjs`) on the desktop.

- Project: https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs (MIT license, see `LICENSE`)
- Files: `quickjs-amalgam.zip` from the v0.18.0 release, unchanged
  (SHA-256 of the zip: `6c05066a6b62b483e2ba0f83d7a16688c6958182b214bfd693529434cef84a9e`)
- Built without `QJS_BUILD_LIBC`: plugins get no file system, process or network access.

To update it, download `quickjs-amalgam.zip` from a newer release and replace these files.
